EXPLANATORY

NOTE

The information given by a manufacturer or a supplier according to the above data sheet will enable a purchaser to evaluate the product before he finally decides to purchase a particular brand or type. The International System (SI ) Units have been used in the standard. For guidance, the relationship of pressure unit Pascal ( Pa ) to other units is given below: 1 Pascal ( Pa ) = 1 newton/square = 0'102 kgfjm2 5
